glorious_deeds.description: Each Glorious Deed can only be carried out once per game, but several times across a campaign.
effects: +1 Victory Point toward winning the game
ELITE models that carry out Glorious Deeds receive +1 Experience Point
+1D6 to Promotion Pool after the game

glory_points.description: Earned by carrying out Glorious Deeds. Spent in Quartermaster Step to purchase Battlekit/models costed in glory, Glory Items, or Mercenaries.

campaign_phase_steps.name: Trauma Step
campaign_phase_steps.description: Check what happened to models taken Out of Action.

campaign_phase_steps.name: Promotions & Experience
campaign_phase_steps.description: Promote Troops, record XP, learn Skills.

campaign_phase_steps.name: Reinforcements
campaign_phase_steps.description: Call for reinforcements if heavy losses. Forfeits Exploration and Quartermaster steps.

campaign_phase_steps.name: Exploration
campaign_phase_steps.description: Roll Exploration Dice to discover locations and collect loot.

campaign_phase_steps.name: Quartermaster
campaign_phase_steps.description: Recruit models, hire Mercenaries, buy/sell/reallocate Battlekit, purchase Glory Items.

campaign_phase_steps.name: Roster Update
campaign_phase_steps.description: Final update to Warband Roster. Ready for next game.

troops.description: Roll D6 for each Troop taken Out of Action.

elite.description: Roll D66 for each ELITE model taken Out of Action.
elite.battle_scars: Each OOA = +1 Battle Scar. At 3 Battle Scars = Unfit for Duty (removed).

trauma_table.name: Dead
trauma_table.effect: Remove model and Battlekit from roster.

trauma_table.name: Captured
trauma_table.effect: Negotiate ransom in ducats. If not paid, executed. If paid, Full Recovery.

trauma_table.name: Severe Nerve Damage
trauma_table.effect: All Success Rolls treated as Risky Success Rolls.

trauma_table.name: Hand Wound
trauma_table.effect: -1 DICE to Melee attacks with weapon in injured hand.

trauma_table.name: Lost an Eye
trauma_table.effect: -1 DICE to Ranged Attacks. Second time = blinded, removed.

trauma_table.name: Chest Wound
trauma_table.effect: +1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls targeting this model.

trauma_table.name: Insomniac
trauma_table.effect: Must be first deployed. Loses INFILTRATOR.

trauma_table.name: Head Wound
trauma_table.effect: Cannot gain XP. Assign Promotion Dice as Troop. Roll of 6 regains XP.

trauma_table.name: Shell-shocked
trauma_table.effect: First deployment: D6, on 1-2 = -1 DICE for rest of game.

trauma_table.name: Dark Memory
trauma_table.effect: -1 DICE to Melee vs models from Warband that caused injury.

trauma_table.name: Paranoid
trauma_table.effect: Cannot deploy within 8" of friendly model.

trauma_table.name: Lost Arm
trauma_table.effect: Cannot use 2-hand Battlekit. Only one 1-hand item.

trauma_table.name: Leg Wound
trauma_table.effect: -2" Movement. -1 DICE to Dash Risky Success Roll.

trauma_table.name: Expensive Treatment
trauma_table.effect: Must deduct 10 ducats before deploying.

trauma_table.name: Possessed
trauma_table.effect: First ACTION must be Dash away 3" if >1" from enemies.

trauma_table.name: Muscle Damage
trauma_table.effect: Cannot have HEAVY Battlekit. Existing HEAVY items lost.

trauma_table.name: Minor Wound
trauma_table.effect: Cannot be used in next game.

trauma_table.name: Robbed
trauma_table.effect: All Battlekit lost. No Injury or Battle Scar.

trauma_table.name: Full Recovery
trauma_table.effect: No ill effects. No Injury or Battle Scar.

trauma_table.name: Hardened
trauma_table.effect: Gains NEGATE FEAR. No Injury or Battle Scar.

trauma_table.name: Bitter Lessons
trauma_table.effect: Gains D3 extra Experience Points. No Injury or Battle Scar.

trauma_table.name: Prominent Scar
trauma_table.effect: +1 DICE to Melee vs causing Warband. No Injury or Battle Scar.

promotions.description: Troops can be Promoted to ELITE status using Promotion Dice.
promotions.dice_pool: 1D6 base + 1D6 per Glorious Deed carried out in the game.
promotions.assignment: Assign dice to Troop models. Cannot assign 3rd die until all Troops have 2, etc.
promotions.success: Roll a 6 = Promoted to ELITE. After 5 consecutive non-6 rolls, next roll is automatic 6.
promotions.on_promotion: Gains ELITE Keyword. Starts with 0 XP but gains 1 for surviving.

sources.condition: ELITE model survived the game (even if taken OOA)
ELITE model performed at least 1 Glorious Deed

experience.advancement: When XP reaches a circle-marked box on roster, make an Advancement Roll.

steps: Pick two Skill Tables to roll on
Roll 2D6 on each table, look up available Skills
If rolled Skill already owned, use next lowest (or highest)
If Patron Skill rolled, use one from your Patron
Pick one of the two Skills to learn

reinforcements.description: If your Warband took heavy losses, you may call for Reinforcements instead of Exploring and visiting the Quartermaster.
reinforcements.condition: Optional — forfeits Exploration and Quartermaster steps for this phase.
reinforcements.effect: Receive free Troop models to bring Warband back to minimum viable strength.
reinforcements.troops_received: Up to 3 Troop models (no Battlekit) from your Faction's basic Troop options.

quartermaster.description: Manage your Warband's equipment and recruitment.

actions.name: Recruit Models
actions.description: Recruit new Troop or ELITE models from your Faction list by paying their Cost in ducats.

actions.name: Hire Mercenaries
actions.description: Hire Mercenaries by paying their Cost in glory.

actions.name: Buy Battlekit
actions.description: Purchase Equipment from your Armoury Tables.

actions.name: Sell Battlekit
actions.description: Sell Equipment for half its Cost (rounded down).

actions.name: Reallocate Battlekit
actions.description: Move Equipment between models in your Warband freely.

actions.name: Purchase Glory Items
actions.description: Buy Glory Items using glory points, limited by your current unlock tier.

actions.name: Dismiss Models
actions.description: Remove unwanted models from your Warband (no refund).
